system_description.narrative_title: U.S.-Iran conflict evolves into economic and energy warfare
system_description.narrative_summary: Across the window the dominant narrative is that the U.S.-Iran war has moved beyond episodic strikes into a coordinated mix of kinetic action, naval interdiction and financial pressure that is choking Iran's exports and reverberating through global commodity and banking markets. U.S. strikes and a de facto blockade are compressing Iranian oil flows while Treasury secondary sanctions target Gulf banking links, prompting financial scrutiny in Dubai and Egypt and driving trade toward alternative partners such as China. These processes create reinforcing feedbacks—escalatory military reprisals, tighter sanctions, higher oil/commodity prices, and regional realignments—that amplify global inflation, supply-chain stress, and geopolitical tension.
system_description.scope: Military strikes, naval operations and control of the Strait of Hormuz; U.S. secondary sanctions and Treasury actions against banks; flows of Iranian oil and other commodities (helium, tankers); regional state responses (UAE, Egypt, Saudi Arabia) and great-power reactions (China); immediate effects on global energy, shipping and financial markets.
system_description.super_system: Global geopolitical-economic system (international security, energy markets, finance and trade)
adjacent_subsystems: International banking, dollar clearing and sanctions enforcement
Gulf regional security and maritime trade infrastructure
evidence_headlines: U.S. strikes Iranian rocket launchers near Strait of Hormuz
U.S. Navy blockade slashes Iran oil exports as Trump administration shifts to economic warfare
Treasury moves to sanction UAE branch of Egyptian bank over Iran ties
Global oil prices top $91 a barrel after U.S. and Iran exchange fire for the first time in a month
China warns US it could retaliate over Iran sanctions
US and Iran exchange fire for the first time in more than a month

variables.name: Military engagement intensity
variables.description: The overall scale and tempo of kinetic operations and direct hostilities across the conflict zone.

variables.name: Naval control of key waterways
variables.description: The degree of operational control, interdiction capability and freedom of movement exerted over strategic maritime chokepoints.

variables.name: Sanctions pressure level
variables.description: The cumulative intensity of economic penalties, restrictions and targeting measures applied to limit an adversary's economic activity.

variables.name: Secondary sanctions scope
variables.description: The breadth and enforceability of measures that extend penalties to third-party financial and commercial links.

variables.name: Oil export flow
variables.description: The volumetric rate of crude and refined fuel shipments leaving the producer region and entering global markets.

variables.name: Global oil price level
variables.description: The prevailing market price for benchmark crude reflecting supply, demand and risk premiums.

variables.name: Shipping route risk
variables.description: The perceived and measured probability of disruption, attack, or delay along major maritime trade corridors.

variables.name: Tanker incident rate
variables.description: The frequency of attacks, accidents or interdictions affecting merchant tankers and bulk carriers in the region.

variables.name: Cross-border banking access
variables.description: The ease and availability of correspondent banking, dollar clearing and international payment conduits for regional trade.

variables.name: Financial transaction frictions
variables.description: The level of delays, compliance costs and counterparty risk that impede cross-border financial flows.

variables.name: Trade reorientation rate
variables.description: The speed and magnitude at which commercial flows shift toward alternative partners and routes in response to pressure.

variables.name: Commodity supply shortage
variables.description: The degree to which critical commodities (e.g., fuel, helium, shipping capacity) are constrained relative to demand.

variables.name: Global inflationary pressure
variables.description: The aggregate upward pressure on consumer and producer prices driven by commodity costs, supply disruptions and policy responses.

variables.name: Market risk premium
variables.description: The additional yield, volatility or price markup markets assign to assets because of geopolitical and supply-chain uncertainty.

variables.name: Escalation feedback pressure
variables.description: The reinforcing dynamic that increases the probability and intensity of reciprocal responses following hostile actions.

variables.name: Munitions stock level
variables.description: The aggregate reserves of weapons, ordnance and consumable military supplies available to sustain operations.

catalysts.title: US announces new Iran-related bank sanctions
catalysts.description: US Treasury to announce additional bank sanctions targeting institutions that enable Iran's trade and dollar clearing, likely within days. This will expand legal and compliance risks for third‑party banks.
catalysts.rationale: Bessent says US likely to announce Iran bank sanctions this week; Treasury moves against Egyptian bank, UAE branch cited.

catalysts.title: Continued US strikes on Iranian targets
catalysts.description: A near‑term campaign of US strikes on Iranian military and infrastructure targets is likely to continue as tit‑for‑tat exchanges escalate.
catalysts.rationale: Multiple headlines: US strikes Larak, Kharg; Trump vows to 'hit them hard' and US launches further strikes.

catalysts.title: Iran asserts/presses control over Strait of Hormuz
catalysts.description: Iranic naval and mine warfare efforts to assert control or intermittently close the Strait will continue, disrupting transit and elevating regional leverage.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Strait of Hormuz remains closed', Iran navy 'full control', and mine warfare hampers US control.

catalysts.title: Further tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz
catalysts.description: Attacks on oil tankers and merchant shipping are likely to recur, sustaining insurance and transit disruptions across key routes.
catalysts.rationale: Two tankers hit in Strait; multiple reports of tankers struck and rising oil price after attacks.

catalysts.title: US blockade further restricts Iranian oil exports
catalysts.description: Ongoing US naval interdiction and enforcement measures will continue to sharply limit Iran's ability to export crude and refined products.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'U.S. Navy blockade slashes Iran oil exports' and 'Blockade succeeds where sanctions failed'.

catalysts.title: Expanded secondary sanctions against third‑party banks
catalysts.description: US escalation of secondary sanctions will target banks handling Iranian trade, prompting compliance reviews and enforcement actions in the Gulf and beyond.
catalysts.rationale: Treasury imposes limits on Egyptian bank, targets UAE/Egypt branches; reporting of weekly new US secondary sanctions.

catalysts.title: China deepens regional diplomatic and economic ties
catalysts.description: China's high‑level visits and statements signal increased diplomatic engagement and potential alternative trade/banking channels for regional actors, affecting reorientation away from US mechanisms.
catalysts.rationale: Xi lands in Egypt; headlines note China could benefit and warns US over sanctions, reshaping alliances.

catalysts.title: U.S. munitions depletion and replenishment pressure
catalysts.description: Sustained operations are draining U.S. munitions stocks, creating pressure to resupply and influencing pacing and intensity of future operations.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Drain on U.S. Munitions' and 'America’s Systemic Munitions Shortfall' raise replenishment concerns.

catalysts.title: Intermittent diplomacy and pressure around interim deal
catalysts.description: Sputtering talks and Iranian calls to comply with an interim deal could produce episodic pauses or conditional de‑escalation if US reciprocates; outcomes remain uncertain.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Iran urges US to comply with interim deal' and 'Iran talks sputter' indicate fragile diplomacy.
